purpose: Freeze the pre-execution authority for the GNU extension stage before any of it is measured. Contains no measured outcome and must not be result-shaped after execution.

kernelTelemetry.staleBy: three stages of compiler change; must be refreshed before prioritisation

items: __attribute__ syntax, preserved on every declaration it can attach to
e-class analysis lattices: constant value and known bits
bounded tiered rewrite scheduler with match fuel and no-progress stop
requiredWork.orderingRule: Front-end items are implemented in the order refreshed kernel telemetry ranks them, not in the order listed. The list is scope, not sequence.

fixedOrder: 1. Refresh telemetry: re-run reconnaissance at the baseline commit with the frozen 16-TU cohort unchanged, seal it with the pinned observer, and classify every failed lane by root construct. First diagnostics truncate at the first error, so classification uses the reduced reproducers and further reductions within the window, not the first diagnostic alone.
2. Route: each failure is assigned to exactly one of {this stage, preprocessing hardening, other}. The E0104 unknown-compiler lanes are preprocessing hardening and do not enter this stage.
3. Specification revision 1.9, docs-only, reviewed before any test encodes it.
4. Tests-only red window: kernel-derived parser fixtures for the lanes routed here; synthetic semantic fixtures per construct, differential across both interpreters; lattice and scheduler fixtures.
5. Implementation in telemetry order. Each construct closes its own declared red set.
6. Publication: the parse and preprocess percentages are produced by a tracked script from observer-sealed evidence, per lane, with the command beside each number.

mustFreeze: C-HIR representation of an attribute list: name, arguments as written, source span, attachment point; preserved losslessly regardless of whether a semantic is applied
which attributes have a semantic in this stage and what it is; every other attribute is preserved and recorded as not applied, by name, in the receipt
typeof of a type and of an expression; an expression operand is not evaluated unless its type is variably modified, which this stage rejects

statement expression: value is the last expression statement, a trailing declaration or non-expression statement yields void, block-scoped objects end at the closing brace, lowering to EvoIR block structure
designated initializer paths as SubobjectPath steps, later designators overriding earlier ones, and the diagnostic for a designator outside the object
compound literal: an object with an allocation site in the shared manifest, automatic in block scope and static at file scope
analysis lattices: constant value and known bits, their join, and that facts only ever narrow within one saturation transaction
scheduler tiers, match fuel, epoch budget, and the no-new-best stop rule, all recorded in the certificate so a checker can confirm the budget was respected

requiredTestProperties.kernelDerived: Every lane routed to this stage has a fixture reduced from the real translation unit, sealed by the observer, that fails at the baseline and passes when its construct lands.
requiredTestProperties.noSilentAcceptance: A construct this stage does not implement is rejected with a named diagnostic, never parsed as something else. An attribute that is preserved but not applied is visible in the C-HIR dump.
requiredTestProperties.differential: Every semantic fixture executes identically in the C-HIR and EvoIR interpreters; statement-expression sequencing and designated-initializer overriding are checked by observable side effects, not by final value alone.
requiredTestProperties.lattices: A known-bits fact that enables a fold is exercised by a program whose fold is impossible without it; facts never widen within a transaction.
requiredTestProperties.scheduler: Budget exhaustion returns the byte-identical input; the no-progress stop fires on a corpus where saturation would not; the certificate records epochs and fuel consumed.
requiredTestProperties.dashboardMonotone: Dual-oracle clean parse and raw preprocess counts do not regress against the refreshed telemetry. A construct that fixes one lane must not break another.

gate.roadmapGate: Kernel parse and preprocess percentage is published automatically.
gate.form: Process gate: the publication exists, is reproducible from sealed evidence, and names its command. It is deliberately not a predicted percentage; the previous stage that froze an outcome number before its telemetry existed could not be closed.
gate.cohort: The 16-TU cohort is unchanged. Changing it to move a percentage is the failure the cohort freeze exists to prevent; representativeness is a later stage's question.

outOfScope: E0104 unknown-compiler and all header or predefined-macro hardening
attribute semantics beyond the frozen list

processRules.redWindow: One tests-only checkpoint opens the window; failures come from declared missing constructs, never from a build error or malformed fixture; no commit widens the declared set; each implementation commit narrows it; the final one closes it.
processRules.noTestSuppression: No commit disables, deletes or ignores a test.
processRules.telemetryFirst: No production edit before step 1 and step 2 are complete and sealed.
processRules.timebox: Telemetry refresh and routing: half a day. Specification: one day beyond review. Implementation: three days. Overrun is reported, not absorbed.

acceptance.measuredOnly: Every figure is measured, labelled with what it counts, and accompanied by its command.
required: every lane routed to this stage is green, or is named as still failing with its root cause
publication script produces the dashboard from sealed evidence and is tracked
dual-oracle clean parse and raw preprocess counts are at or above the refreshed telemetry
full regression, Clippy with warnings denied, format check, diff check, two isolated offline clone replays
